subject.title: fix(memory): scale heap pressure thresholds to V8 limit

question: Should explicitly configured Node V8 heap limits change Gateway’s restart-driving heap-pressure policy from the fixed 2 GiB critical threshold to proportional thresholds?
rationale: The implementation and proof support the distinction, but deciding whether later critical escalation is acceptable for existing operator-configured deployments is an operational availability policy choice.

options.title: Accept proportional explicit-limit thresholds
options.body: Merge after rebasing and required checks, accepting that direct operator heap limits use the new warning and critical thresholds while managed defaults retain historic behavior.

options.title: Keep fixed restart thresholds
options.body: Do not merge this policy change and retain the current 2 GiB critical trigger for all Gateway heap-limit sources.

options.title: Define a separate operator policy
options.body: Pause for a documented configuration or product decision if explicit heap overrides need a different operational contract than either existing or proposed behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept proportional explicit-limit thresholds
recommendation.body: Merge after rebasing and required checks, accepting that direct operator heap limits use the new warning and critical thresholds while managed defaults retain historic behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence only identifies the contributor who implemented and documented the proposed policy boundary; a current-main Gateway owner should be added during maintainer review.
